rapport_notes: Gracious and non-defensive when the customer balked at the $575 minimum for a single bed move.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "do you have any other questions or concerns or important things that you wanted to answer within this call?" -- asked in the same breath as the quid pro quo, before any other question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Call ended on the price objection right after the differentiator recitation -- none of the five lines were reached.

top_strength: Accepted the price objection gracefully without arguing or sounding put out, preserving the relationship for a future call.
coaching_note: Jumped straight from the differentiator pitch to quoting the flat $575 minimum with no anchor/range framing at all -- a quick 'typical single-item moves like this run X to Y' framing before the number might have softened the sticker shock.
